title: Empty-set coefficient of a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in(0,1)$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The biased Fourier coefficient at the empty set of the function that returns the sign in coordinate $i$ equals the bias mean $1-2p$.
